title: I²C addressing
description: read manufacturer ID at 0x44.

title: Dark reading
description: cover the housing aperture; reading should fall below 1 lux.

title: Bright reading
description: drive a known bright source; reading should be within ±20 % of a reference lux meter at the housing surface.

title: Full-range sweep
description: dark → indoor → direct sunlight; no stuck-state or skipped-range behaviour from auto-range mode.

title: Brightness lookup table re-fit
description: characterise the V2.9 housing aperture's transfer function from outside illuminance to OPT3004 raw reading at multiple ambient levels (direct sunlight, indoor office, twilight, night helm, total dark). Re-fit the lookup so the firmware brightness loop produces the same perceived display brightness vs ambient as the prior hardware revision did. Apply DGUS II step-boundary hysteresis.

title: Default-off at power-up
description: no audible chirp during the first 500 ms after VDD comes up with AUDIO_PWM unconnected.

title: Single-tone correctness
description: 2 kHz square wave produces audible tone at expected loudness.

title: Tone-palette sweep
description: 1 kHz to 4 kHz in 100 Hz steps; record any resonant peaks / dips for firmware library tuning.

title: Default-off recovery
description: tone stops immediately when AUDIO_PWM is released to high-impedance.

title: Current draw at full duty
description: peak / average VDD-side current consistent with calculated ~313 mA peak / ~156 mA average.

title: Reverse polarity
description: Apply −12 V to NET-S. Pass if VS+ stays at 0 V with no component heating.

title: Normal operation
description: Apply 12 V. Pass if VS+ ≈ 11.25 V (within the ~750 mV drop budget).

title: OVP trip
description: Slowly raise supply voltage. Pass if VS+ drops to 0 V between 17.5 V and 19.5 V with no oscillation. *(Verified at 18.6 V on both MDD400 and WTI400 prototypes.)*
result: Verified at 18.6 V on both MDD400 and WTI400 prototypes.

title: OVP hysteresis
description: After trip, slowly reduce supply. Pass if VS+ recovers cleanly below the trip point.

title: PTC fuse
description: Briefly short VS+. Pass if F1 trips and the board recovers without intervention after the fault clears.

title: Bleed resistor
description: Remove supply; pass if VS+ reaches < 1 V in approximately 4.4 s (R54 × 44 µF).

title: EMI filter ripple
description: Scope VS+ at 242 mA load. Pass if supply ripple stays below the LMR51610 V_IN tolerance.

title: Filter capacitance at bias
description: Measure C43, C45, C46, C47 at 12 V DC bias; record actual values against the derated filter corner-frequency calculations.

title: D7 clamp under transient
description: Inject a representative fast transient onto VS+. Pass if VS+ stays below the INA219's 40 V VS abs-max.

title: INA219 current reading
description: At 242 mA nominal load, confirm the INA219 reading is within ±5 % of a bench ammeter cross-check.

title: F1 thermal proximity to D10
description: After an IEC 61000-4-5 surge sequence, confirm F1 body temperature stays below 70 °C.

title: L3 cold-start inrush
description: Confirm peak current through L3 at power-on stays below the 2.6 A saturation rating.

title: Bus idle — recessive state
description: With TWAI_EN LOW, measure CANH and CANL at J2. Pass if both sit at approximately 2.5 V.

title: Transceiver enable
description: Assert TWAI_EN HIGH. Pass if U5 enters normal mode with no bus disturbance on a scope.

title: TXD default
description: Before TWAI initialised, measure TXD at U5 pin 1. Pass if HIGH (R17 holding recessive).

title: TWAI loopback
description: Configure the TWAI peripheral in self-test/loopback mode; transmit a frame. Pass if received without error.

title: Receive on live network
description: Connect to an NMEA 2000 network; capture traffic with a CAN analyser. Pass if frames are received at 250 kbps with no error frames.

title: Transmit on live network
description: Send a test PGN. Pass if the frame appears on the network and is acknowledged by another node.

title: Bus fault survivability
description: Apply a brief over-voltage to CANH / CANL at J2; confirm U10 clamps and U5 survives. Note the 4 V clamp-vs-spec margin.

title: Default-off at power-up
description: VDSP < 50 mV at J4 with DISP_EN unconnected.

title: Power-on transition
description: Q4 gate pulled to ≤ 0.5 V within one GPIO cycle after DISP_EN goes HIGH.

title: VDSP rail under display load
description: within ±2 % of VDD with no dip below 4.85 V, even under animated UI + 100 % backlight.

title: Operating-current characterisation
description: record peak VDD current at several backlight settings; confirm well within Q4 (4.2 A) and FB3 (3 A) ratings. (Performance review used 400 mA as a conservative estimate; replace with measured value.)

title: Hard-reset recovery
description: drive DISP_EN LOW for 10 ms, then HIGH; T5L re-boots and DGUS II commands resume.

title: UART round-trip and touch-event reception
description: see the per-sub-circuit bring-up lists above.

title: Brightness lookup re-calibration
description: the V2.9 housing and ALS placement differ from the prior hardware revision. The existing ALS-reading → DGUS II brightness step lookup table must be re-characterised on the V2.9 prototype before the firmware can be deployed on this hardware. Bench-test at multiple ambient illuminances (direct sunlight, indoor office, night helm, totally dark) and re-fit the curve. Apply hysteresis at each DGUS II step boundary.

title: VCC rail under Wi-Fi TX
description: Probe at U3 pad 2 during a sustained 802.11b TX burst. Pass if the rail stays within ±3 % of 3.30 V with no individual dip below 3.10 V.

title: EN release timing
description: Trigger on VCC rising; capture ESP_EN. Pass if ESP_EN crosses 2.48 V ≥ 10 ms after VCC reaches 3.0 V.

title: BOOT pull-up integrity
description: Capture ESP_BOOT over a 60 s window during normal operation. Pass if it sits stable at VCC with no glitches.

title: Default-on at power-up
description: Apply VCC with LED_EN unconnected (or firmware-controlled GPIO held high-impedance). Pass if D2 illuminates within a few milliseconds of VCC reaching its nominal value, before firmware starts.

title: Firmware-off control
description: Boot firmware; configure LED_EN as a GPIO output and drive it HIGH. Pass if D2 fully extinguishes within one GPIO cycle and stays off until LED_EN is released or driven LOW.

title: I_LED measurement
description: Probe across R14 with Q1 on. Calculate I<sub>LED</sub> from V<sub>R14</sub> / 390 Ω. Pass if I<sub>LED</sub> is between 2.5 mA and 3.5 mA (allowing for amber LED V<sub>F</sub> spread).

title: Visibility check
description: Confirm D2 is clearly visible through the front-panel housing aperture at typical operating viewing angle. If too dim, reduce R14 in a future revision; if too bright, increase R14.

title: Apply 12 V to J3 pin 1
description: VST regulates at 12.0 ± 0.5 V.

title: Apply 9 V to J3 pin 1
description: VST ≈ 8.1 V (dropout); LED current still ≥ 2.9 mA and ST_RX responds to bus signal.

title: Apply 16 V to J3 pin 1
description: VST regulates at 12.0 ± 0.5 V; U11 junction ΔT < 2 °C.

title: Reverse polarity / swapped pins
description: Apply −12 V or swap pin 1 and pin 2. Pass if VST = 0 V and no component damage.

title: Idle bus
description: ST_RX ≈ VCC (≥ 2.9 V).

title: Force LOW via 1 kΩ to GND
description: ST_RX ≤ 0.4 V.

title: 4800 baud test pattern
description: UART RX captures correct framing with no errors.

title: 38400 baud (NMEA 0183 HS) test pattern
description: UART RX captures correct framing with no errors.

title: NMEA 0183 listener compliance
description: Input current at J3 pin 3 = 2.0 V stays ≤ 2.0 mA (target ~0.36 mA).

title: VST = 9 V (dropout) RX behaviour
description: I_LED ≥ 2.0 mA; ST_RX transitions correctly with no missed edges.

title: ST_EN HIGH (or undriven)
description: ST_SIG sits at VST (~12 V via R37); transmitter off.

title: ST_EN LOW, ST_TX HIGH
description: ST_SIG = VST; Q10 not conducting.

title: ST_EN LOW, ST_TX LOW
description: ST_SIG < 50 mV; Q10 conducting and bus pulled LOW.

title: 4800 baud rising edge
description: ST_SIG reaches ≥ 80 % VST within 50 µs (rise-time assist functioning).

title: 9600 baud rising edge
description: ST_SIG reaches ≥ 80 % VST within 30 µs (assist effective after C48 rework).

title: VST = 16 V
description: D9 (V_Z = 15 V) zener leakage / dissipation stays ≤ 200 mW.

title: 58 V transient on ST_SIG (clamped upstream)
description: Gate driver and Q10 survive.

title: QR-code URL resolution
description: Scan S6 with a phone. Pass if the resolved URL matches the live docs URL exactly. *(Earlier MDD400 hardware revisions had a `docs.scadys.com` → `docs.scadys.io` URL transition; the V2.9 schematic footprint reads `docs.scadys.io` but verify on the as-fabricated board.)*

title: Compliance-mark legibility
description: Photograph all silkscreen marks at typical helm-position lighting. Pass if every mark is clearly readable at arm's length.

title: Copyright year currency
description: S8 reads "© 2025". The V2.10 production run should refresh the year if it's manufactured after 2026.

title: Pick-and-place fiducial recognition
description: Confirm at the start of the V2.10 production assembly run that the pick-and-place machine successfully detects FID1–FID4 on both F.Cu and B.Cu without manual override.

title: I²C addressing
description: read manufacturer ID at 0x40.

title: PGA configuration
description: confirm firmware writes PG1:PG0 = 0b10 (PGA /4).

title: Calibrated current accuracy
description: within ±1 % at full-scale (~485 mA), ±5 % at 10 % FS.

title: Bus voltage accuracy
description: within ±1 % against a calibrated DMM.

title: Shunt self-heating drift
description: < ±0.5 % drift over a 30-minute soak at 250 mA peak.

title: Output-voltage accuracy
description: Probe VCC at TP1 and VDD at the inductor-side of FB2 with no Wi-Fi or display activity. Pass if 3.30 V ± 2 % (VCC) and 5.00 V ± 2 % (VDD).

title: Output ripple at full load
description: 100 MHz scope with ≤ 5 mm-tip ground. For VCC sustain an 802.11b TX burst; for VDD set DWIN backlight to 100 %. Pass if < 50 mV pp at 400 kHz on both rails.

title: IC case temperature soak
description: 10 min worst-case load at 85 °C enclosure ambient (or scaled). Touch-probe U1 and U6. Pass if case < ~95 °C (Tj < ~115 °C). Hotter readings are a strong DRG-package-swap signal.

title: Snubber decision
description: 500 MHz scope on each SW node with low-inductance ground spring; capture rising edge. Pass without snubber if peak ringing < ~1 V above V_in; otherwise populate R7+C9 (VCC) or R23+C24 (VDD).

title: Dual-converter common-mode EMI pre-scan
description: Capture conducted-emission spectrum on the VSD input with both converters running. Look for 400 kHz / 800 kHz / 1.2 MHz peaks rising above margin. This is the test that motivates the V2.10 phase-staggering work below.

title: End-to-end programming via ESP-PROG
description: Flash a known image at 921600 baud through the standard ESP-PROG adapter and cable. Pass if the image flashes cleanly, the device boots, and Wi-Fi associates.

title: VDD-only operation
description: Disconnect the ESP-PROG cable; power the board from VDD alone. Pass if the LDO produces 3.30 V ± 2 % and the ESP32 boots normally (confirms the D4 OR'ing path).

title: D3 back-feed check
description: Power the board from its own VDD only; probe J1 pin 1 (V_PROG). Pass if pin 1 measures < 0.1 V above VDD − V_F(D4); any larger reading indicates leakage on the OR'd node.

title: U4 thermal soak under Wi-Fi TX
description: Sustained 802.11b TX for 30 minutes from cold start; record U4 body temperature with a thermocouple every 5 minutes. Pass if peak Tj stays below 110 °C in a 70 °C-ambient soak chamber, or below 80 °C at room ambient. Tj > 110 °C is a strong V2.10 signal to expand the F.Cu pour or add thermal vias.

title: I²C addressing
description: read CONFIG register at 0x48; default value 0x60A0 confirms presence.

title: Room-temperature reading accuracy
description: within ±2 °C of a reference instrument.

title: Hot-soak response
description: local heat application produces an immediate reading rise.

title: Long-duration helm-position soak
description: log temperature at 1 Hz over a representative sun-loaded helm session. Use the data to tune the three firmware thresholds (alert / derate / shutdown).

title: ALERT pin reachability
description: *(optional)* — confirm R62 holds ALERT high at idle and the open-drain output pulls cleanly when triggered.

title: OPT3004 INT pull-up
description: if a future firmware revision wants to interrupt-drive on threshold crossings, the open-drain INT pin needs an external pull-up to V<sub>DD</sub>. Currently absent. Polled mode in current firmware doesn't require it, so this is a forward-looking item.

title: CISPR 32 conducted-emission scan including the buzzer drive net
description: the R10 / C12 / R9 filter is calculated to attenuate harmonics above ~7.2 kHz, but no measurement has been performed. Include the buzzer drive net in the prototype's conducted-emission scan during V2.10 compliance pre-screening.

title: Re-run the buzzer-filter simulation with V2.9 component values
description: R10 4.7 Ω, C12 4.7 µF, R9 10 Ω. Record operating conditions (PWM frequency, duty cycle, load impedance). Add the simulation source to `design-docs/`. The waveform images currently sourced from V2.8 old-docs have unrecorded operating conditions and should be superseded.

title: D10 sourcing for production
description: Qualify a Littelfuse or STMicro equivalent SM8S36CA for CE / ABYC certification; the current FUXINSEMI part is suitable for prototype but not preferred for production compliance documentation.

title: D7 substitution if loaded clamp exceeds 40 V
description: Swap to a lower-standoff part (e.g. PESD12VL1BA, ~34 V clamp at 200 W) if the V2.9 bench measurement shows the INA219 VS abs-max could be reached.

title: D8 proximity
description: Tighten D8 to within 2 mm of Q6's gate/source (currently 3.0 mm) to reduce the gate loop area.

title: OVP threshold margin at temperature
description: At 85 °C the OVP threshold reaches 15.1 V — only 300 mV above the 14.8 V NMEA 2000 maximum charging voltage. Raise the margin by adjusting R45 / R46, or replace the divider-only comparator with a voltage-reference design for temperature-stable operation.

title: Over-temperature disconnect
description: Add a genuine thermal cutout: wire a normally-closed thermal switch (85 °C or 100 °C, e.g. Murata PKGS series) in series between R44 and GNDREF, plus a 100 kΩ pull-up from Q6's gate to its source. Place the switch adjacent to the hottest component (Q6 or L3 / L4).

title: R33 Kelvin routing
description: Verify INA219 IN+ and IN− sense traces leave the inner edges of R33's pads, separate from the main VS+ power traces, to minimise current-measurement error.

title: C36 population decision
description: Resolve DNP status after EMC testing; either populate or remove the footprint.

title: NMEA 2000 certification
description: The physical layer meets ISO 11898-2 but formal NMEA 2000 certification has not been pursued; required before any commercial release.

title: TWAI_TX damping footprint
description: No series resistor is fitted on TXD. Add a DNP 0603 footprint to allow evaluation at bring-up without a board respin.

title: Tighten C18 placement
description: Move C18 adjacent to U5 pin 3 to reduce the bulk-bypass trace from ~5.6 mm to ≤ 3 mm.

title: U10 clamp margin
description: U10 clamps at 40 V @ 5 A while the SN65HVD234DR bus-fault spec is ±36 V. Confirm U5 survives the worst-case bus fault before committing to a production run; if marginal, swap U10 for a lower-clamping CAN TVS array.

title: C37 dielectric / voltage-derating confirmation
description: confirm the Murata "BZ" series code corresponds to a temperature characteristic (X5R vs Y5V / Z5U) where the effective capacitance at 5 V DC bias remains ≥ 4.7 µF. If derating is severe, swap for an X5R-rated 10 µF / 25 V 0805 part.

title: DISP_TX / DISP_RX series damping if traces ≥ 50 mm
description: already tracked under `## esp32-module` in `v2.10-improvements.md`; cross-referenced from this page because the damping resistors belong adjacent to each transmitter (U3 DISP_TX pad and the display module TX pad respectively).

title: LCSC URLs in schematic
description: C37, C38, and FB3 KiCAD property fields currently reference LCSC datasheet URLs. Replace with Murata manufacturer URLs in a V2.10 schematic pass.

title: DISP_TX / DISP_RX series damping
description: Likely longer traces than the J1 path; same 33 Ω damping policy if > 50 mm. The damping resistors belong adjacent to the *transmitter* output (U3 DISP_TX pad and the display module TX pad respectively).

title: ESP_TX / ESP_RX trace length verification
description: Measure actual routed length in the KiCAD PCB editor. If either trace exceeds 50 mm, add 33 Ω series damping at the U3 output pads per the ESP-PROG Hardware Guide. (Straight-line distance is ~29.5 mm; routed length not yet extracted.)

title: 38400 baud TX support
description: Requires further reduction of C48 to ~220 pF (pulse too short for cable runs > 2–3 m) or a redesigned assist stage (constant-current source or firmware-adaptive baud-rate detection).

title: C30 dedicated bypass at U7 pin 6
description: Currently 3.3 mm; add a dedicated 100 nF 0603 adjacent to pin 6 if bring-up shows high-speed switching issues.

title: C48 rework on existing V2.9 boards
description: Change C48 from 2.2 nF to 820 pF (R59 unchanged at 12 kΩ). Same 0603 C0G footprint; update schematic value and rework all assembled units before TX bring-up.

title: C49 / C50 schematic metadata
description: KiCAD lists the wrong manufacturer part (GRM188R71H104KA93D, 100 nF); the correct part is GRM1885C1H101JA01D (100 pF). Assembled BOM is correct; fix the schematic property fields.

title: Connector swap to M12 3-pin
description: Replace J3's proprietary Raymarine-compatible THT footprint with an M12 A-code or B-code 3-pin male panel-mount socket (IP67, field-wireable). The SeaTalk I pin assignment (power / ground / signal) maps directly. No circuit changes required.

title: D9 proximity to ST_SIG boundary
description: Confirm D9 is within 5 mm of the isolation boundary; relocate closer in V2.10 for better transient suppression.

title: Guard ring around U7 isolation gap
description: Marine salt-spray increases ionic creepage risk on uncoated boards; add an unconnected guard trace if conformal coating is not specified.

title: LDO bypass distances
description: Move C55 (currently 9.2 mm from U11 VIN) and C54 (currently 5.0 mm from U11 VOUT) to within 2 mm of their respective U11 pins. Confirm via DRC.

title: PCB creepage slot at U8 / U9
description: The 1.4 mm copper-free gap meets IEC 60747-5-5; a milled PCB slot increases creepage. Evaluate when CE marking or MED certification is pursued.

title: Rise-time-assist component placement
description: C48, Q11, R36, R40, R42, R47, R59, R61 PCB positions were not recoverable from review data; confirm placement relative to Q12 in the PCB editor.

title: Compliance test reports
description: The CE, UKCA, and FCC marks on the silkscreen indicate the device is designed for compliance with the corresponding standards. The actual *test reports* that authorise affixing those marks are part of the V2.10 compliance pre-screening campaign (CISPR 32 conducted emissions, FCC Part 15 radiated, RED 2014/53/EU harmonised standards). The marks should not be affixed on production boards until the test reports are signed off.

title: Copyright year update
description: Refresh S8 to the V2.10 production year if it differs from 2025.

title: Re-scan QR code URL
description: Confirm the deployed URL still matches the silkscreen QR on the V2.10 PCB before fabrication.

title: Kelvin sense connection at R33
description: verify in the V2.10 layout pass that IN+ / IN− tap from the *inner* edges of R33's pads (not from a downstream point), so the sense voltage is exactly V<sub>R33</sub> rather than V<sub>R33</sub> + trace drop.

title: Shorten sense-pair routing
description: the IN+ / IN− pair currently runs ~60 mm from R33 (in the CAN bus-power section) to U2 (in the sensor cluster). Move U2 closer to R33 or route the sense pair on an inner layer away from SMPS switching activity to tighten common-mode rejection.

title: Address dual-converter in-phase 400 kHz EMI
description: *(conditional on V2.9 EMC pre-scan)* — both LMR51610 instances run fixed-frequency with no phase synchronisation; in-phase coincidence sums common-mode emissions at 400 kHz and its harmonics. Options: spread-spectrum LMR variant; deliberate frequency offset via an RT-pin component on one converter (only if a frequency-trim pin is exposed on the chosen variant); a sync-capable converter with deliberate 180° phase shift; or — if EMC still passes — accept and document.

title: Concentrated thermal via array under each LMR51610 GND pin
description: *(conditional on V2.9 thermal soak)* — DBV/SOT-23-5 has no exposed pad; add a tight cluster directly under each IC's GND pin if margin proves tight.

title: Swap U1 / U6 to LMR51610XDRGR (DRG package, exposed pad)
description: *(if VCC or VDD continuous load grows, or if V2.9 thermal soak shows IC case > ~95 °C)* — DRG θJA = 48 °C/W vs DBV's 148 °C/W. ~20 °C extra Tj headroom on each rail; same improvement as the WTI400 V1.3 backlog.

title: Switch L1 / L2 from Fenghua FNR5040S220MT (prototype stock) to Bourns SRN5040TA-220M (production BOM)
description: same footprint; ~+0.4–0.5 % efficiency per rail and a guaranteed SRF spec.

title: ESP_TX / ESP_RX trace-length verification
description: Straight-line distance is ~29.5 mm; extract actual routed length in the PCB editor. If either trace exceeds 50 mm, add 33 Ω series damping at the U3 output pads per the ESP-PROG Hardware Guide. Cross-referenced from the [ESP32 Module](./esp32-module) page.

title: Expand U4 F.Cu pour / thermal vias
description: *(conditional on V2.9 thermal soak)* — If the 30-minute Wi-Fi TX soak shows Tj exceeding 110 °C at 70 °C ambient, increase the 64 mm² F.Cu pour and / or add to the 16-via thermal cluster under the tab. The HT7833 tab is V_IN (Net-(D3-K)), **not GND** — layout must not connect to GNDREF.

title: Tighten U4 V_IN decoupling
description: The nearest dedicated capacitor to U4 V_IN is C22 (100 nF) at ~3.3 mm — outside the ≤ 1 mm tight-decoupling guideline. Stable at the load currents in use; add a dedicated 100 nF 0603 adjacent to U4 V_IN if any oscillation is observed during the thermal soak.

title: Add 100 nF X7R bypass on TMP112 V<sub>CC</sub>
description: in parallel with C57 (100 pF). TMP112 datasheet §9.2 recommends 100 nF minimum; the V2.9 100 pF C0G is below this guideline. At the TMP112's ~50 µA idle current the risk is low, but adding the 100 nF would follow the datasheet and reduce susceptibility to supply glitches during I²C transactions.
